body.x: Checkall presented Smart Network Connecter, RJLED, which enables effective network management, at “2017 Korea Electronics Show (KES)” held at COEX, Samseong-dong, from Oct. 17 (Tue) to 20 (Fri).

The creation by Checkall is 'RJLED' which can detect the location of a pair of cables with a computer chip and an LED built in the RJ45 connector at both ends of the cable. It was completed at the end of two years of research and development and it was first disclosed at the 2017 KES. Currently, two patents are registered. Overseas PCT applications and individual patent applications are under way in various countries around the world.

Baek, Seung-bum, a representative of Checkall, said "Smart network connector is the world's first development, and it shortens the maintenance time as well as work speed with 100% accuracy. Many organizations are constantly inquiring about it." he said. "In addition to the RJLEDs we launched this year, Checkall plans to release one ICT innovation each year," he said.

Meanwhile, KES 2017, hosted by Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Energy and sponsored by KEA (Korea Electronics Association), is an international show where lots of potential buyers, governments, group officials participate, providing a good place to experience world first products like mobile phone, semiconductor, display, and next generation convergence solutions like industrial convergence, IT convergence, digital broadcasting, smart education and e health.
